topics.description: Medicaid fraud is a growing concern in Minnesota, with the state spending $20 billion on programs at high risk for fraud since 2018. The issue is being investigated by the Minnesota DHS.
topics.reason: Recent reports of high-risk Medicaid programs

topics.description: There have been several reports of potential misconduct by federal officers in Minnesota, including the detention of a Hmong-US citizen and the investigation into potential crimes during Metro Surge.
topics.reason: Recent allegations of federal officer misconduct
